question: Who transmitted the teaching to the earth-moving yoginīs who are good eaters?
premises: They are described as good eaters
inference: An earth-mover transmitted the teaching to the earth-moving yoginīs who are good eaters.
uncertainties: The meaning of subhakṣāṇāṃ ('good eaters' or 'having good food/offerings') is context-dependent.
plain_english: O beloved, it was told by an earth-mover to the earth-moving yoginīs, the good eaters.
